articles.summary: Boonton, NJ resident Allen Apgar has been elevated to the position of 2nd Vice President / Senior IT Manager. In this role, Apgar leads day-to-day operations of the bank’s IT team, including oversight of systems, security, and network maintenance.
articles.title: Boonton Resident Named 2nd VP / Senior IT Manager by Kearny Bank

articles.summary: Pictured (from left): Antonio DiPasquale, Justin Gusmano, Tom Woroniecki, Glen Corson, Devon McClellan, and Karla Pichardo. articles.summary: Presented in conjunction with the NJSIAA (New Jersey State Interscholastic Athletic Association), this $2,500 scholarship honors a New Jersey scholastic athlete who perseveres to overcome significant injury or illness and returns to competition.
articles.title: Allentown H.S. Student-Athlete Wins 2026 Strength Award Scholarship from Kearny Bank, Presented in Conjunction with NJSIAA
